Station on a tall post at left with a solar panel. Amber radio rings spread down a flooded bungalow street toward a small hub at the far end, and the station is reflected in the water. Caption reads Its radio signal can carry more than a half-mile in streets.
Rings fade. A dashed scale bar draws up the street, and a More than a half-mile amber tag pins near the hub at 29.4 to 29.6. The hub mast lamp starts to light at 29.8. Same street caption.
Scale bar, tag and lit mast lamp held on the flooded street. The caption is gone by 30.8.

Street held at 31.0. At 31.2 cut to open green country with a chain link fence, a tan hub with a mast and Hub label, and a Station inset at upper left. Amber arcs leave the inset. Caption reads In open country, up to five miles, to a hub.
Rings from the inset grow across the sky. An Up to five miles in open country tag pins at 32.2 to 32.4. The mast lamp glows and the hub window lights at 32.6.
Concentric amber rings keep spreading over the open-country hub. Tag, mast lamp and lit window held. Some ring strokes show faint colour fringing.
Same open-country hub with rings and five-mile tag held. The caption disappears at 34.8.

Open country held to 35.2. At 35.4 cut to the hub interior: a seated responder in a navy jacket at a desk with a monitor titled Flood path map showing a blue creek line, plus mug and keyboard. Disclosure reads Illustration. Not a real hub.

A tag reading A second, larger model pins above the monitor. Yellow station dots appear along the creek on the map, and the responder's hands shift on the keyboard. Caption reads At the hub, a second, larger AI maps.
Desk composition held with dots on the map and the model tag. Small hand movement at the keyboard. Same caption.

Desk at 38.0. At 38.2 cut to a full-frame Flood path map. An orange path spreads along the creek from the left at 38.6, and orange branches run down streets at 38.8. Caption reads flood paths for responders.
Orange flood paths complete on the map. At 39.6 a Higher risk legend and a For emergency responders tag pin, and dashed amber zone outlines draw around the low streets.
Map held with three dashed higher-risk zones and the responders tag. The caption ends at 40.4, and the map holds without a caption to 40.8.

Cut to a cork notice board on posts over a flooded lawn and street. At 41.2 a Validation accuracy card pins with an empty bar and the line Reported by the university, and an amber ring marker appears at the bar start. Caption reads The university reports early chip AI validation.
Orange tape fills the validation bar from left to right behind the ring marker, reaching the end around 42.6 to 42.8. Same caption.
Bar full and the marker gone. A second blue pushpin appears at the card's right corner at 43.6. Notice board and flooded street held.
Card with full bar and two pins held on the board. The caption disappears at 44.6.
Slightly closer on the card. 98.82% fades in above the bar at 45.4 and is fully legible from 45.6. Caption reads Accuracy was ninety eight point eight two percent.
An Initial assessments after training tag swings in and pins under the validation card. Same caption.
At 47.4 a blank Field result card slides in from the right beside the tag, and a yellow pushpin presses it home at 47.8.
Validation card, assessments tag and blank Field result card held on the board. The caption ends around 48.6.

Cut at 49.2 to a standing figure in a green coat holding a rubber stamp in front of the board, with the cards now smaller at left. Disclosure reads Illustration. Not a real report or map. The arm lifts the stamp. Caption reads The announcement reports no field result.
The figure's arm swings the stamp over the cards. At 50.6 a None reported stamp mark appears on the Field result card, then the arm lifts again.
The arm with the stamp moves back down to waist height, and the figure ends standing with both hands low. None reported stays on the card.

At 52.2 cut to the same figure beside a chain link fence with a pipe post, a city skyline and a pond behind. A faint outline appears, then at 52.8 a paper grid map with a blue creek pins to the fence. Caption reads It names no town with an installed station.
The figure raises an arm and points across the paper map, the finger moving along the creek and then upward over the grid.
The finger points on the map. At 54.4 a dark Announcement names no installation tag pins at the top of the map, and the arm returns to the side.

Fence and map held to 55.4. At 55.6 cut to a wide curb scene: porch rail, flooded street, a small technician holding a paper and a case, a thin dashed station outline on a post, live oak and skyline. Caption reads Deployment is still the goal.
The technician holds a plan sheet in front of the torso. An amber arc starts at 56.4, and by 56.6 an amber ellipse rings the dashed station outline. A Field result None reported tag pins at right.
A Deployment goal amber tag pins at 57.0. The caption shows to 57.2 and is gone by 57.4. From 57.6 to 57.8 the technician lowers the sheet to an angle at waist height.

Held: the technician, about a fifth of frame height, with the plan sheet tilted at the waist. A thin dashed station outline inside the amber ellipse, with the Deployment goal and Field result tags at right. No caption. The sheet is not seen entering the case.
The same tail composition holds at 59.0 and 59.2. At 59.4 cut to a dim credits card fading in, fully bright by 59.6: Texas AI Docket wordmark with Lone Star flag, URL, and source and music credits.
Static credits card: The Daily Dispatch, Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com, UT San Antonio Today September 8th, and the Sincerely music credit.
The same static credits card continues unchanged, with wordmark, flag, URL, sources and music credit legible.
The static credits card continues identically, with Texas AI Docket wordmark, flag, URL, and source and music lines.
Static credits card unchanged across all five samples: wordmark, flag, URL and credit lines.
Static credits card held through the final frame at 64.367 s: same wordmark, flag, URL and credits.
